subject: CentralUS2: Livepatch rollout & opt-in for driver validation
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Acme Infrastructure <infra@acme.com>, Jason Lee <jason@fleetco.com>, Tidal Ocean SRE <sre@tidalocean.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Jul 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: CentralUS2: Livepatch rollout & opt-in for driver validation

Hi all —

TL;DR: On Tuesday 2027-07-20 we plan a staged livepatch and driver validation in CentralUS2. Most hosts will receive a no-reboot livepatch; a small subset (canary pool) will undergo a brief driver reload that may cause 30–90s token-generation smoothing. We are offering an opt-in for customers who want earlier inclusion in the canary group for validation.

What we're changing
- Kernel livepatch that reduces CPU contention during NVMe driver handoffs.
- Targeted driver reload on ~3% of inference hosts (canary group) to validate the driver handshake.

Why this approach
- Livepatch avoids full node reboots for 97% of capacity.
- Canary driver reloads let us measure latency tails and KV-cache persistence in a controlled way.

Schedule (target window)
- Tuesday, 2027-07-20 — 02:00–06:00 UTC (CentralUS2 maintenance window).
- Canary group will be updated in first 45 minutes; broader livepatch in the following 3 hours.

Impact and mitigation
- Expected: transient latency spikes (p50 unchanged, p95 may increase up to ~400ms for affected requests).
- Avoids cold-start reboots; services should remain available.
- Automatic fallback routing to compatible model variants if an instance exceeds error thresholds.

If you want to be in the canary group (early validation)
- Reply to this thread with: "OPT-IN-CANARY" plus preferred contact and a best ETA for a short joint test (we'll run a 10–15 minute validation with your SRE). We will cap canary size for safety.

Attachments: centralus2-livepatch-plan.pdf (pdf), canary-list.csv (csv)

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
viv@redwood.com

From: Jason Lee <jason@fleetco.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Acme Infrastructure <infra@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Jul 2027 14:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CentralUS2: Livepatch rollout & opt-in for driver validation

Thanks for the heads up, Vivek. FleetCo would like to OPT-IN-CANARY.

A few quick Qs:
1) Can you confirm whether embeddings jobs are in-scope for the canary? We run long embeddings batches overnight.
2) If we see persistent latency >500ms during the validation, what's the rollback SLA?

Point of contact: Jason Lee (jason@fleetco.com), available Tue 02:15–03:00 UTC for the validation window.

—Jason

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Infrastructure <infra@acme.com>, Jason Lee <jason@fleetco.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 08:06:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CentralUS2: Livepatch rollout & opt-in for driver validation

Vivek / team —

Per Jason's opt-in, I'll assign FleetCo to Canary cohort #2. Notes for ops runbook:
- Canaries: select hosts from canary-list.csv; ensure no long-running embedding batches are scheduled there.
- If embeddings are detected mid-validation, throttle to background tier and notify customer.
- Rollback window: operator-initiated rollback should complete within 12 minutes for an affected host; global rollback (stop the broader livepatch) target is <30 minutes from trigger.

Grace: please coordinate SRE on telemetry thresholds (we use 3xx errors or p95 > 500ms for 5 consecutive min to trigger rollback).
Laura: will you publish the post-run brief and customer-facing postmortem template to the shared Drive link after the window?

Marissa
Senior Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: CentralUS2: Livepatch rollout & opt-in for driver validation

On Mon, Jul 19, 2027 at 08:06 AM Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com> wrote:
> Vivek / team —
> 
> Per Jason's opt-in, I'll assign FleetCo to Canary cohort #2. Notes for ops runbook:

Thanks — I’ve added FleetCo to the canary CSV and scheduled their validation slot at 02:20 UTC.

Quick operational checklist (for the run)
- Pre-check (T-30m): KV cache health, model pin confirmation, confirm no scheduled heavy embeddings on chosen hosts.
- Canary update (T+5m after beginning): verify service health, p50/p95, error rates; run 10-min synthetic load from customer endpoint.
- Escalation (if thresholds met): pause rollout, immediate fallback routing to compatible variants, notify customers and open internal incident channel.

I'll post the final canary roster to the Drive link once Marissa confirms.

Grace O'Connor
Site Reliability Lead
Redwood Inference
grace@redwood.com
